name: mereca-croche
description: Sistema completo para loja artesanal Mereça Crochê

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const server = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const client = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { server.kill(); client.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
